tasks.label: Place Duck Box
tasks.desc: The rubber duck is placed into the pink box; the arms must agree on the box pose before the duck is released.

tasks.label: Stack Basin
tasks.desc: The basin and its contents are transported and stacked, which needs both arms to hold a consistent picture of the object's motion.

tasks.label: Store Block
tasks.desc: Blocks are moved from the tray into the storage bin, so one arm's placement depends on where the other has left the bin.
